remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Stretcher inscription 1 may be date of preparatory work. Backing inscription dates 1921. O'Keeffe wrote: "I had an alligator–pears–in–a–large–dark–basket period. One painting is dark with a simplified white scalloped doily under the basket" (*Georgia O'Keeffe* [1976], unpaginated, text accompanying entry 31). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Two green pears rest inside a brown basket with a large handle.  The basket sits on a white doily, which, in turn, lies on a pink surface.  The background is a plain white.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Tim Nighswander/IMAGING4ART
